resources.string_add: Save this correction to the preview. Keep placeholders, links and HTML unchanged. Your site changes only when you apply the job.
{0} translation conflicts need attention. Saved originals are retained. Retry restoration after resolving the changes.
English-only editing is available when English is the site default.
Skipping keeps the saved English and existing translations, and allows another editing session without generating a translation preview.
Translation plan skipped. Saved English and existing translations are retained.
{0} English keys were created or changed. Previous language settings have been restored.
Pause the other languages together, save your page or block in English, then restore the previous language settings.
Previous language settings have been restored. No English page or block text changed.
Install another site language before using English-only editing.
Other languages are temporarily hidden from visitors. Existing translations are saved. Finish here after saving your page or block.
Create or skip this translation plan before starting another editing session.
Create one plan for the affected keys across all supported languages that were previously enabled. Generate and review its preview before applying.
A translation plan is saved for the affected keys. Open it to generate and review the preview.
English-only editing is active. Open Pages and save your changes, then return here to restore the languages.
The provider cannot translate these restored languages: {0}. Their existing text is preserved.
Finish English editing and restore languages before creating, generating, applying or rolling back translation jobs.
Generation is complete. Correct the flagged strings in step 2 before applying. Your saved previews are preserved.
Preview saved. Apply the reviewed job when you are ready.
